item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring thundery showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, it will be hot over the coastal areas of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week, but there will still be a few showers.

Date/Month: 02/07 (Sunday)
Wind: South force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier in some areas.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
